notes.title: Patch 0419
notes.notes: Some core code has been modified, and now you can activate Skip mode by pressing the S key or clicking "Skip".

notes.title: Patch 0301_1
notes.notes:
The situation simulation mini-game has added a mid-return button.
HINA's character illustration animation on the main screen will now react according to the stage.
Prevent operations during transitions.
Fixed some errors in the storyline presentation.
Reduced the difficulty of some mini-games.
